escena: SCENE (the client is talking, first review meeting of a coffee chain's growth plan, Bogota, golden hour): Julio is the one RECEIVING. He is seated in three-quarter view, mouth CLOSED, eyes fixed off-frame to the right on whoever is speaking, one hand still on the table beside a pen he is not using. Caught at the instant he takes in what was just said: his brows have started to lift and his head is barely turning towards the speaker, the listening is mid-movement, not a held pose. He wears the navy Efeonce softshell jacket, zip halfway, over a plain dark tee, with the Efeonce lanyard at his neck, its badge hanging FACE-INWARD against his chest so only the blank back of the card is visible: this is a meeting, and the jacket is the register that says so. His own laptop is closed in front of him. Across the table, out of focus and cropped by the frame edge, a forearm gestures over a printed plan. Behind him a wall screen is awake with an azure-blue chart, throwing cool light along his jaw, while the low sun coming through the blinds lays warm bars across the table. 85mm at f/2, focus on his eyes. Text exists on the printed plan but sits at a steep angle well outside the focal plane, unreadable. Everything is completely unbranded except the Efeonce garments.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut meeting table on the camera side
